observed: Step 1: the Past due menu reads, top to bottom: "Any" (ticked, as no range is), "All ranges are included. Pick one or more to narrow.", "1-30 days", "31-60 days", "61-90 days", "91+ days".
Steps 2-4: ticked "91+ days": chip "Past due: 91+ days"; then "31-60 days": "Past due: 2 ranges"; then "1-30 days": "Past due: 3 ranges".
Step 5: ticked "61-90 days": the chip reads "Past due: 4 ranges", not Any; the "Any" row is not ticked (the menu shows "4 selected").
